scenes.title: Surgery in Germany
scenes.summary: The doctor says Chef Barinov needs an expensive surgery in Germany, and Eleonora plans to borrow the money from a friend.

scenes.title: Who Is Boss in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: With both Barinov and Lyova out, Senya and Fedya argue over who should run the kitchen.

scenes.title: Democratic Elections
scenes.summary: Timur proposes holding democratic elections between Senya and Fedya to choose the temporary chef.

scenes.title: The Thoroughbred Pony
scenes.summary: Mikhail receives a miniature pony for his gambling debt, while Katya struggles to tell Nikita about Denis.

scenes.title: Discounted Fish
scenes.summary: Senya buys questionable fish at a steep discount from Timur and shares the kickback to buy votes.

scenes.title: A Buyer for Horsemeat
scenes.summary: Mikhail is horrified when Timur's acquaintance offers a tiny sum to buy the pony for horsemeat.

scenes.title: The Japanese Refuse the Fish
scenes.summary: The Japanese delegation rejects Senya's spoiled fish, Mikhail docks everyone's pay, and Senya eats the fish himself.

scenes.title: An Overnight Stay for the Pony
scenes.summary: Mikhail hides the pony in the locker room overnight while Katya apologizes to Denis for the delay.

scenes.title: The Cousin Pianist
scenes.summary: When Nikita's father catches Katya kissing Denis, she claims Denis is her cousin, a pianist flying to Tokyo.

scenes.title: Fedya's Coffee Break
scenes.summary: Fedya declares a coffee break for the kitchen crew and refuses to cook incoming restaurant orders.

scenes.title: Fined for the Break
scenes.summary: Eleonora fines the kitchen crew a day's wages for Fedya's coffee break and checks her wealthy friend Alyokhin into a suite.

scenes.title: The Runaway Pony and the Vote
scenes.summary: Mikhail chases the escaped pony upstairs, Timur starts the kitchen voting, and Nikita's father runs into Denis.

scenes.title: Bitten by a Mad Horse
scenes.summary: The runaway pony bites Eleonora's wealthy friend Alyokhin, ruining her chance to borrow the surgery money.

scenes.title: The Secret Ballot
scenes.summary: Timur takes a bribe during the kitchen election and announces Senya as the winner.

scenes.title: Payback for the Fish and Pony
scenes.summary: Senya falls ill from the bad fish, Fedya exposes the rigged election, and Eleonora confronts Mikhail about the pony.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Punishment
scenes.summary: Eleonora punishes Senya, Fedya, and Mikhail for the chaos and orders Ainura to clean up after the pony.

scenes.title: The Talented Nephew
scenes.summary: Eleonora covers for Katya by pretending Denis is her nephew, then learns Alyokhin refused the loan.

scenes.title: Help from the Whole Team
scenes.summary: Elena sells her jewelry and the entire restaurant staff pools their money to help pay for Barinov's surgery.

scenes.title: Bad News from the Clinic
scenes.summary: Mikhail donates his personal savings, but Elena learns from the German clinic that the surgery will cost twice as much.

scenes.title: Katya's Choice
scenes.summary: Nikita announces that his father will pay for Barinov's surgery, forcing Katya to give up Denis and go through with the wedding.
